projects.name: End of the World
projects.description: There may be more to the map than the middle.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Yin and Yang recipes.

trigger.pending: Take the next step in Core production

projects.name: Final Robotics
projects.description: Make the Final Frame and Final Cannon in the Fabricator. Together they make a Suppression Bot 70 AP in the Bot Plant.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Final Frame and Final Cannon. Pair them in the Bot Plant or combine them with earlier parts.
projects.flavorText: Management has approved another layer of management.

projects.name: A Remarkably Indirect Conclusion
projects.description: Complete this project to achieve victory and keep playing in this world.
projects.unlock: Victory achieved.
projects.flavorText: The factory may continue after its point has been made.

projects.name: Resource Relocation
projects.description: Move Forests, mineral deposits, and defeated Golem reserves within their map. They keep their stock.
projects.unlock: Move Forests, mineral deposits, and defeated Golem reserves within their map. They keep their stock.

projects.name: Lake Relocation
projects.description: Move Lakes within their map. Pumps stay connected. Select a Pump with the Lake to move them together.
projects.unlock: Move Lakes within their map. Pumps stay connected. Select a Pump with the Lake to move them together.

projects.name: Monster Camp Relocation
projects.description: Move a Monster Camp and its linked Tribute boxes together within their map.
projects.unlock: Move a Monster Camp and its linked Tribute boxes together within their map.

projects.name: Efficient Landfill
projects.description: Reduces the Deep Hole Stone requirement by 20% each time, compounded before rounding up. Stone already delivered still counts. The minimum is 1 Stone, with up to 45 completions.
projects.unlock: Reduces the Deep Hole Stone requirement by 20% each time, compounded before rounding up. Stone already delivered still counts. The minimum is 1 Stone, with up to 45 completions.

projects.name: Advanced Road Channels
projects.description: Adds one Road slot per map side each time, up to five slots total.
projects.unlock: Adds one Road slot per map side each time, up to five slots total.

projects.name: Train Freight Capacity
projects.description: Each completion adds space for 20 items per Train and 1 item per Road shipment.
projects.unlock: Each completion adds space for 20 items per Train and 1 item per Road shipment.

projects.name: Resource Regeneration
projects.description: Each completion adds the pre-upgrade regeneration rate again to Forests and mineral deposits.
projects.unlock: Each completion adds the pre-upgrade regeneration rate again to Forests and mineral deposits.

projects.name: Intermediate Recycling
projects.description: Supply Water to break down items and run unlocked waste recovery recipes in the Recycler. Use Filters to sort the output.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Recycler.

projects.name: Water Tools
projects.description: Draw Water from a Lake with a Pump, then use a Hydro Plant to make Coolant.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Pump, Hydro Plant, and Coolant recipe.

trigger.pending: Visit a map with a Lake

projects.flavorText: Water was here first. You have found a use for it.

projects.name: Mythril Refining
projects.description: Make Mythril Plates in the Smelter and Mythril Gears and Wire in the Refiner. Use the Synthesizer to make Pure Mythril.
projects.unlock: Unlocks Mythril Gear and Mythril Wire in the Refiner, Mythril Plate in the Smelter, and the Synthesizer.

trigger.pending: Produce Mythril Tribute at a Dwarven settlement

projects.flavorText: A rare material with very ordinary demands.

projects.name: Advanced Fabrication
projects.description: Build a Fabricator for advanced intermediates, Cores, and Bot Plant parts.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Fabricator.
projects.flavorText: More complicated things can now go wrong.

projects.name: Waste Handling
projects.description: Collect mixed waste in a Waste Bin. Use Filters to send each waste type where it belongs.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Waste Bin.
projects.flavorText: Waste has been promoted to logistics.

projects.name: Hydrochemistry
projects.description: Make Copper Slurry in a Hydro Plant.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Copper Slurry recipe.
projects.flavorText: The water has joined Production.

projects.name: Hydraulic Assembly
projects.description: Make Hydro Pistons and Circuit B in the Fabricator.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Hydro Piston and Circuit B recipes.
projects.flavorText: Progress, under pressure.

projects.name: Fluid Routing
projects.description: Build a Fluid Tank to buffer up to 256 units of Water or Coolant.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Fluid Tank.
projects.flavorText: The pipes would like a plan.

projects.name: Sealed Robotics
projects.description: Make Sealed Frames and Cooled Guns in the Fabricator for the Bot Plant. Together they produce a Suppression Bot 3 AP.
projects.unlock: Unlocks Sealed Frame and Cooled Gun for bot assembly.
projects.flavorText: The machinery would prefer to stay dry.

projects.name: Ore Separation
projects.description: Make Mythril Mesh in the Synthesizer.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Mythril Mesh recipe.
projects.flavorText: Keeps the valuable part. Sends an invoice for the rest.

projects.name: Mineral Recovery
projects.description: Use a Recycler to turn 4 Metallic Fines and 1 Water into 1 Iron Plate.
projects.unlock: Iron Plates can now be recovered from Metallic Fines.
projects.flavorText: The rubbish was not entirely rubbish.

projects.name: Pressure Systems
projects.description: Each Pump connected to a Lake draws up to 8 Water per second.
projects.unlock: Lake Pumps now draw up to 8 Water per second.
projects.flavorText: The pressure is now an engineering choice.

projects.name: Heavy Robotics
projects.description: Make Mythril Frames and Focused Guns in the Fabricator for the Bot Plant. Together they produce a Suppression Bot 8 AP.
projects.unlock: Unlocks Mythril Frame and Focused Gun for bot assembly.
projects.flavorText: Subtlety was considered and found underpowered.

projects.name: Precision Control
projects.description: Make Controllers, Servo Pistons, and Circuit C. This also unlocks the Waste Bin and Iron Plate recovery from Metallic Fines.
projects.unlock: Unlocks Controller, Servo Piston, and Circuit C recipes.
projects.flavorText: Fewer errors. More precise ones.

projects.name: Autonomous Logistics
projects.description: Use Storage to deposit materials in a shared pool across maps. Retrieve them by connecting Inventory to a Filter.
projects.unlock: Unlocks Storage and Inventory.
projects.flavorText: The materials can arrange their own commute.

projects.name: Command Robotics
projects.description: Make Servo Frames and Pulse Cannons in the Fabricator for the Bot Plant. Together they produce a Suppression Bot 24 AP.
projects.unlock: Unlocks Servo Frame and Pulse Cannon for bot assembly.
projects.flavorText: Management has acquired heavier equipment.

projects.name: Mineral Regeneration 2
projects.description: Mineral deposits now regenerate 1 unit every 15 seconds at their base rate. Unlocks repeatable upgrades to that rate.
projects.unlock: Base mineral regeneration increases to 1 unit every 15 seconds.
projects.flavorText: A slightly less geological timescale.

projects.name: High Pressure Intakes
projects.description: Each Pump connected to a Lake draws up to 16 Water per second.
projects.unlock: Lake Pumps now draw up to 16 Water per second.
projects.flavorText: The Lake has received a larger request.

projects.name: Factory Templates
projects.description: Save factory layouts as templates and preview the whole layout before placing it.
projects.unlock: Unlocks factory templates.
projects.flavorText: Repeat your successes. Also your layout.

projects.name: Tree Planter 1
projects.description: Tree Planter cycles take 10% less time than the base cycle.
projects.unlock: Tree Planter cycles take 10% less time than the base cycle.
projects.flavorText: The apology is being expedited.

projects.name: Mineral Recovery 1
projects.description: Waste recovery cycles take 10% less time after machine upgrades.
projects.unlock: Waste recovery cycles are 10% shorter.
projects.flavorText: Same rubbish. Shorter meeting.

projects.name: Warehouse Logistics
projects.description: Build a Warehouse to buffer up to 250 items.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Warehouse.
projects.flavorText: A bigger box is still a plan.

projects.name: Road Channels 1
projects.description: Each side of a map can hold two Roads. Sending and receiving Roads share those slots.
projects.unlock: Adds a second Road slot to each side of every map.
projects.flavorText: The border now has a second appointment.

projects.name: Area Expansion 2
projects.description: Make every play area 50% wider and 50% taller than its original size.
projects.unlock: Expands every play area.
projects.flavorText: The extra space has already been spoken for.

projects.name: Mineral Regeneration 1
projects.description: Ordinary mineral deposits regenerate 1 unit every 30 seconds, up to capacity. Depleted deposits stay in place and refill.
projects.unlock: Ordinary mineral deposits now regenerate.
projects.flavorText: The ground has agreed to a slow refill.

projects.name: Road Channels 2
projects.description: Each side of a map can hold three Roads. Sending and receiving Roads share those slots.
projects.unlock: Adds a third Road slot to each side of every map.
projects.flavorText: Congestion now has additional lanes.

projects.name: Mineral Regeneration Rate
projects.description: Each completion adds 20% of the base rate from Mineral Regeneration 2.
projects.unlock: Increases mineral regeneration.
projects.flavorText: Nature has accepted another performance review.

projects.name: Storage Placement Capacity
projects.description: Each completion lets you place one more Storage node across the world.
projects.unlock: Increases the global Storage limit by one.
projects.flavorText: Another place to put off organizing.

projects.name: Inventory Placement Capacity
projects.description: Each completion lets you place one more Inventory node across the world.
projects.unlock: Increases the global Inventory limit by one.
projects.flavorText: Retrieval is becoming a department.

projects.name: Storage Connection Capacity
projects.description: Each completion adds one connection slot to every Storage node.
projects.unlock: Adds a connection slot to every Storage node.
projects.flavorText: The storage problem has more connections.

projects.name: Inventory Connection Capacity
projects.description: Each completion lets every Inventory node connect to one more Filter.
projects.unlock: Adds a Filter connection to every Inventory node.
projects.flavorText: More outlets for accumulated ambition.

projects.name: Efficient Intermediates
projects.description: Unlocks efficient recipes for Circuit A, Motors, and Basic Frames. Use Filters to separate products from waste at the shared output.
projects.unlock: Unlocks efficient Circuit A, Motor, and Basic Frame recipes.

projects.name: Efficient Higher Intermediates
projects.description: Make Efficient Hydro Pistons and Circuit C in the Fabricator and Efficient Mythril Mesh in the Synthesizer. Use the Recycler to recover materials from Spent Flux, Glassy Crust, and Slag.
projects.unlock: Unlocks more efficient recipes and waste recovery.

projects.description: Tree Planters produce growth ten times as fast and can send up to ten growth units in one transfer.
projects.unlock: Increases Tree Planter speed and transfer capacity.

projects.name: Trains
projects.description: Upgrade Trucks to Trains that hold 80 solid items and ship up to 4 items at a time.
projects.unlock: Trucks are now Trains.
projects.flavorText: A larger commitment to putting things somewhere else.

projects.name: Area Expansion 1
projects.description: Make every play area 25% wider and 25% taller than its original size.
projects.unlock: Expands every play area.
projects.flavorText: The factory was only temporarily large enough.

projects.name: Tree Planter
projects.description: Restore Wood to depleted Forests with a Tree Planter.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Tree Planter node
projects.flavorText: The trees have accepted the apology.

projects.name: Mining Drill
projects.description: Feed a Mining Drill 20 Motors to create a 1,000-unit deposit of the selected material.
projects.unlock: Unlocks the Mining Drill node
projects.flavorText: The surface was merely the opening offer.
